steps.en: Put an LLM key and a search-API key in secrets.toml
steps.zh: 把 LLM 和搜索 API 的 key 写进 secrets.toml

steps.en: Run the example script with a retriever and type the topic
steps.zh: 带上检索器跑示例脚本，输入话题

steps.en: Finds perspectives from related articles and simulates writer–expert interviews grounded in search
steps.zh: 从相关文章里找出视角，模拟写手采访靠搜索作答的专家

steps.en: Drafts an outline and refines it against the collected references
steps.zh: 起草大纲，再对照攒下的资料修订

steps.en: Writes each section with inline citations, then polishes the article
steps.zh: 逐节写正文并标注引用，最后润色全文

value.en: A cited, outlined first draft of a long overview article, with every source it used saved beside it
value.zh: 拿到一篇有大纲、带引用的长文初稿，用过的每个来源都另存在旁边

sources: https://github.com/stanford-oval/storm README "Quick Start with Example Scripts" (secrets.toml with OPENAI_API_KEY; python examples/storm_examples/run_storm_wiki_gpt.py --retriever ...)

https://github.com/stanford-oval/storm README "How STORM & Co-STORM works" (perspective-guided question asking, simulated conversation, outline, article with citations, polishing)
